facts.fact: The Malawi Bureau of Standards Act, No. 14 of 2012 (assented 12 July 2012, published 27 July 2012), establishes the Malawi Bureau of Standards as a body corporate with the object of preparing and issuing standards, under a Malawi Standards Board; the captured text names no standard on information technology or data.

note: Excerpt only: sections on the standards themselves were not captured, so no published-standard fact; the Bureau's power to assess quality systems and administer certification (s.4) names no IT or data standard.
